quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: Bristol Myers Squibb Announces Phase 3 ALOFT-IPF Trial (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Topline results of the pivotal Phase 3 ALOFT-IPF trial of admilparant, an oral LPA1 antagonist, in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (60 mg and 120 mg twice daily for at least 52 weeks vs placebo, 1:1:1): the trial met its primary endpoint at the 60 mg dose with a statistically significant improvement versus placebo in absolute change in forced vital capacity (FVC) from baseline at Week 52; at 120 mg admilparant slowed FVC decline but was not statistically significant. Discontinuations due to adverse events were low and similar to placebo in both arms. BMS will complete a full evaluation and engage health authorities to support planned regulatory submissions; topline results of the fully enrolled Phase 3 ALOFT-PPF trial in progressive pulmonary fibrosis are anticipated in early 2027. CMO Cristian Massacesi: the data reinforce admilparant as a promising, clinically meaningful investigational therapy for IPF.
quarterly_data.figure: primary endpoint met at 60 mg (FVC at Week 52); 120 mg not statistically significant; ALOFT-PPF topline early 2027
